scope.sourceProvenance: DRW_RawDxfObject generated locally from scratch by tests/raw_object_string_override_allocation_tests.cpp; no external or repository drawing fixture is read

implementation.change: Added focused refusal controls for string edits targeting an integer group and Int32 edits targeting a string group. The first malformed string case includes a valid earlier edit to ensure validation is atomic before record emission. The readback adapter now selects the target XRECORD while ignoring automatically emitted default plot-style records.
implementation.retry: After refusal, the same dxfRW writer and adapter retry with the corrected override set; emitted bytes match a successful calibration exactly and a fresh libdxfrw read verifies the full XRECORD identity and groups.
implementation.callerState: The complete source DRW_RawDxfObject is compared before refusal and after retry.

evidence.coverage: Existing successful override readback and allocation rollback/retry sweeps pass for AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 in ASCII and Binary. Added four invalid-type/refusal/sentinel-rollback/corrected-retry profiles for AC1024 across both encodings.
evidence.writerIndex: docs/research/p6-dxf-public-writer-test-mention-index-2026-11-16.json was regenerated after the test-source change; it remains navigation evidence only.

limits: The invalid override cases are qualified for AC1024 only; existing positive profiles and allocation sweeps cover the listed seven revisions.
Readback uses a fresh libdxfrw parser. ezdxf is not installed in this environment, so no independent-reader claim is made.
No DWG/DXF fixture or support claim was added or promoted.
